name: Thal'assis Linnaes
desc:
The current Acolyte of the [Lullaby Isles](location:lullaby_isles). A lead ambassador, who works under the [Council of the Moonlit Faith](faction:council_of_the_moonlit_faith), who's work is leading groups of scholars to and from the Greathive Aratel in order to exchange knowledge, updates and information.

In the Strange Missives he wrote about one of the academics of [the Hive](faction:the_hive) "running astray" while exploring the crypts of the [Lullaby Isles](location:lullaby_isles) and trying to steal the heritage, laid upon the walls of the crypts. He was captured and executed (presumably, by burning alive).
